resources.string: Nothing here yet. Apps add their shows here when you watch something.
Up Next cannot read the TV\'s rows.
Up Next needs a permission. Run launcher/build-and-install.sh again, or run: tools/tv.py \'pm grant com.gathin.tvhome android.permission.READ_TV_LISTINGS\'
Ad-blocking DNS is off. The TV uses the normal DNS.
Run launcher/build-and-install.sh again to give the launcher the DNS permission.
The ad-blocking DNS does not answer. The TV uses the normal DNS now and tries again in 10 minutes.
Select an app to pick it up · Back when you finish
Use the arrows to move it · OK puts it down
Sort apps is now Custom order, so your new order stays.
How many tiles each row of Home holds. More tiles make each tile smaller.
How many rows of apps show under the dock before you press Down. More rows make the tiles a little smaller.
The order of the apps after the dock. The dock stays as you set it. Recently used and Most used follow what you watch. If you move an app by hand, the order changes back to Custom order.
Usage access is off, so Home sees only the apps that you open from Home. Run launcher/build-and-install.sh again to give usage access.
Shows what you were watching above the dock, from the apps that share it, for example Prime Video, JioHotstar and Apple TV. Netflix shares nothing. Press Up from the dock to get to it.
Moves apps on Home. Select an app to pick it up, move it with the arrows and press OK to put it down. You can also hold OK on any app and select Move.
Puts another app in one of the dock places.

Plain is black with the glow of the focused app. Aurora, Scenes and Festive are pictures; Scenes changes every hour. The Live backgrounds move slowly. They use a little more power, but Home stays smooth.
Which picture of the background shows. Rotate shows each one in turn.
The background moves a little against the focused tile, so Home has depth. It works with every background except Plain.
Focus, glass and tile motion. Switch it off for the fastest response on a slow TV.
The TV\'s own settings: network, picture, sound, apps and more.
Upstream and this fork each built these parts their own way, and this build holds both. Select a row to switch it. Home uses the new choice when you go back.
Upstream\'s screen, for the settings that this screen does not have.
